title: Square pricing - Free through $149/month per location, plus 2.4%-3.5% transaction fees
clean_text: Square's plans are Free ($0), Plus ($49/month per location), Premium ($149/month per location, lowest transaction rates plus 24/7 phone support), and a custom-priced Pro tier for merchants processing over $250,000/year. Transaction fees vary by method: in-person payments run 2.4%-2.6% (Premium getting the lowest rate of 2.4% + $0.15), online payments 2.9%-3.3% + $0.30, and manually-keyed or card-on-file transactions 3.5% + $0.15. Effective January 13, 2026, Square raised in-person Free-plan fees from 2.6% + 10 cents to 2.6% + 15 cents.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription plus usage-based transaction fees
